title: Le parapluie jaune
summary_en: On a rainy day in Lyon, Thomas gives his umbrella to an old lady on the bus. The next day, she has a surprise for him.

sentences.fr: Hier, il pleuvait beaucoup à Lyon.
sentences.en: Yesterday, it was raining a lot in Lyon.

sentences.fr: Thomas marchait vers la gare avec un parapluie jaune.
sentences.en: Thomas was walking toward the station with a yellow umbrella.

sentences.fr: Il était fatigué et il pensait à son lit.
sentences.en: He was tired and he was thinking about his bed.

sentences.fr: Dans le bus, il a vu une vieille dame.
sentences.en: On the bus, he saw an old lady.

sentences.fr: Elle n'avait pas de parapluie et elle avait froid.
sentences.en: She didn't have an umbrella and she was cold.

sentences.fr: Puis il a souri et il a donné son parapluie à la dame.
sentences.en: Then he smiled and gave his umbrella to the lady.

sentences.fr: « Merci, jeune homme ! » a dit la dame.
sentences.en: “Thank you, young man!” said the lady.

sentences.fr: Thomas est descendu du bus sous la pluie.
sentences.en: Thomas got off the bus in the rain.

sentences.fr: Il a couru jusqu'à la gare.
sentences.en: He ran all the way to the station.

sentences.fr: Il était mouillé, mais il était content.
sentences.en: He was wet, but he was happy.

sentences.fr: Le lendemain, la dame l'attendait à l'arrêt de bus.
sentences.en: The next day, the lady was waiting for him at the bus stop.

sentences.fr: Elle a rendu le parapluie à Thomas.
sentences.en: She gave the umbrella back to Thomas.

sentences.fr: Elle avait aussi un gâteau au chocolat pour lui.
sentences.en: She also had a chocolate cake for him.

sentences.fr: Thomas a rougi et il a dit merci.
sentences.en: Thomas blushed and said thank you.
